user.title: Govee account
user.description: Log in with the e-mail and password of your Govee Home app account.

reauth_confirm.title: Govee login expired
reauth_confirm.description: Govee rejected the stored password for {email}. Enter the current password.

error.app_version: Govee rejected the app version this integration uses. Update the integration.

abort.already_configured: This Govee account is already configured

app_version_too_low.title: Govee rejects the integration's app version
app_version_too_low.description: Govee Cloud refused to log in: "{message}". The integration identifies itself as Govee Home app version {version}, which Govee no longer accepts, so no sensor data is updated. Update the Govee Cloud integration; if there is no update yet, report it to the integration's issue tracker.
